pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Whole adult person in green shirt extending both hands toward a blue ball on a plain small pedestal without touching it, eager expression. A small thought bubble contains same blue ball, shows WANT. Flat solid colors dark outlines, full figure pedestal bubble, ample margins, no text. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
